# ConcentricDiscreteOpticalVortices

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A spatially multiplexed arrangement of multiple discrete optical vortices sharing a common center, forming complex topological structures with nested phase singularities. Provides a novel physical substrate for encoding and manipulating multi-dimensional information in optical computing and neuromorphic systems.
